about: scripts/buildcost's mutant ledger: the TPROBE meter (tests.go), its verdict rule and its guards. TestProbeVerdictRule and TestProbeEvidenceRule run in process and build nothing.

mutants.name: tprobe-verdict-ignores-coverage
mutants.rule: No speed verdict comes from an Ergo form that misses a kill (equal coverage is the entry condition).

mutants.name: tprobe-tie-is-win
mutants.rule: Two rows differ only when their least-to-most ranges are disjoint: overlapping ranges are no difference.

mutants.name: tprobe-gain-needs-every-scenario
mutants.rule: Any gain ports (owner, 2026-11-18): a form faster in one scenario is a win even when another scenario is slower.

mutants.name: tprobe-slower-scenario-hidden
mutants.rule: A win lists every scenario where the form is slower, so the cost of the port is in the receipt.

mutants.name: tprobe-sides-not-symmetric
mutants.rule: The comparison reads the same statistic of both sides, so exchanging them exchanges faster and slower.

mutants.name: tprobe-no-tests-is-a-count
mutants.rule: A run that printed no tests to run, or no test files, gives no count and kills no mutant (NO TESTS IS RED).

mutants.name: tprobe-build-error-kills
mutants.rule: A kill is a pass without the mutant and a test verdict with it: a build error, a skip or a failure without the mutant is none.

mutants.name: tprobe-cold-cache-kept
mutants.rule: A cold row counts only when both cache folders were new.

mutants.name: tprobe-edit-not-applied
mutants.rule: An edit row counts only when the edited file's digest changed.
